text_block_list.name: Debuting Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here she comes, moving up! Here she is!! 
Once again this year from Kyoto, a queen 
in the making spreads her wings!!

text_block_list.name: Debuting Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! First plaaace!! Yes, yes, 
YESSS~~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Even though it's your debut race, 
you sure are full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I heard she's aiming for the Tiara 
too —just like Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ――An Umamusume who resembles me?
choice_data_list: Yeah, rumors seem to be going around.

Yeah, apparently people have been talking 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it that this Umamusume has been 
appearing all over the place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loving Tiara Umamusume, and aiming for the 
Triple Tiara herself—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Isn't that just a regular 'Umamusume 
who looks up to the Tiara Umamusume'?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh. What is that even supposed to mean~! 
Isn't your strike zone a bit too wide to 
call that 'similar'~?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Well, but still, if the Tiara route is 
overflowing with Umamusume like me—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—This might turn out to be another really 
fun year!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll give it everything I've got 
this year too~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And Rhein Kraft runs another race today.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, here she comes, here she comes!! 
Craft-senpai is coming out!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Hey, let me sit next to her! 
Craft-senpaaaai!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ! ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You kids over there~, watch closely, 
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: This is—how a senior runs!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While planting the seeds of admiration for 
Tiara Umamusume in the hearts of so many 
others.
